contexts.text: They had the Law inscribed on themselves.
(Such) also have the Law inscribed on them.
Are inscribed in his book of life; that is, on both his memories, and on his nature. AC 7398.
Thus (the Most Ancient Church) had the doctrine of love and charity inscribed on itself.
Are inscribed on the interior memory... HH 463:2.
(In Jupiter) they have doctrine inscribed on their minds...
When confirmed... they are inscribed on the man.
The interior truths of faith... are inscribed on the internal man...
The internal sense... is then inscribed on both his understanding and his will...
The good and truth inscribed on the intellectual part. Signified.
To say a word... against the truth Divine not as yet implanted or inscribed on man's life. Signified.

All things inscribed on the internal man, are inscribed by the Lord; and the things inscribed there make the very spiritual and celestial life of the man; also, each and all things inscribed there, are inscribed on the love.
(Then) evil remains inscribed on his soul and heart...
Whatever anyone does from love remains inscribed on his heart...
Divine truths are therefore as it were inscribed on (the celestial Angels)... Hence it is, that Divine truths appear to be as if inscribed, or as if implanted and innate, in these Angels. HH 271.

Each thing of thought and will is inscribed on the brain... thus also is inscribed on the universal body... whence... the things inscribed on the memory from the will and the derivative thought are not only inscribed on the brain, but also on the whole man... (Thus the book of life, means) that all the acts and thoughts are inscribed on the whole man.
All things of Heaven are inscribed on this love.
The quarters are as it were inscribed on an Angel...
Therefore these three degrees are inscribed on man...
They... have wisdom inscribed on their life, and not on their memory... But those in spiritual love have wisdom inscribed on their memory...
Into this place every man Angel is inscribed... DP 69. DP 307:2. DP 307:end.
Every evil... is inscribed with its penalty.
That it does not appear to anyone, because it is inscribed on their life. Signified, Explained.
In the man on whose life (His precepts) are inscribed: and they are inscribed on man by willing and doing them.
By written, or inscribed, is signified the acknowledgement in them.
The genuine Conjugial is more deeply inscribed on the minds of Christians...
Polygamic love... is inscribed on the natural man.
That all things of faith and love are inscribed on the spirit of man. Signified.
To write = the things which are inscribed and implanted in the life. Illustrated.
They had Divine truths inscribed on themselves.
That the Knowledges of truth are inscribed on the love...
